newsitem.title: USA: Corning alters securities' conversion ratio.
newsitem.headline: Corning alters securities' conversion ratio.

text.p: Corning Inc said Monday it had adjusted the conversion ratio on Corning Delaware LP six-percent Cumulative Convertible Monthly Income Preferred Securities after spinning off former subsidiaries.

The company said each security, which had a liquidation preference of $50 per unit, will be convertible through Corning Delaware LP into shares of Corning common stock at the rate of 1.5340 shares per unit.
It said the ratio had a conversion price of $32.5938 per share of Corning common stock.
Corning spinned off health care services Quest Diagnostics Inc and Covance on December 31.
Before it spun off its subsidiaries, the company said the ratio was 1.2821 shares of Corning common stock for each unit. The conversion price was equivalent to $39.00, it said.
On July 18, Corning issued 7.5 million shares valued at $374 million of six-percent Convertible Monthly Income Preferred Securities.
